headline: Honda Shifts Motorcycle Assembly to Jalisco to Offset Autoparts Drop
summary: Honda opened a second production line in Jalisco to manufacture 66,000 larger-displacement motorcycles, replacing falling autoparts production and avoiding layoffs.
why: Automotive manufacturing adjustments reflect shifts in regional demand and production line allocation.

impacts.name: Honda Motor Co., Ltd.
impacts.why: Plant reallocation alters manufacturing output mix in Mexico.
